plain: The person who brings a charge or lawsuit.

webster.text: A prosecutor; one who prosecutes by complaint, or commences a legal process against an offender for the recovery of a right or penalty.

example.quote: But in more modern books you will find only special warrants to search such and such houses, specially named, in which the complainant has before sworn that he suspects his goods are concealed; and will find it adjudged that special warrants only are legal.
example.cite: James Otis, Argument Against Writs of Assistance, 1761
